Hi Ellen — attaching our package and providing the requested clarifications inline below. Please see attached files: redwood_privileged_provisioning_matrix_v1.pdf, scim_attribute_map_v2.csv, sso-saml-implementation-notes.docx

1) Privileged provisioning and separation of duties- We operate role-based admin tiers: Tenant Admin, Delegated Admin, Support Admin, and System Admin. Each tier has a documented approval workflow. Tenant Admins are provisioned via SCIM (recommended) or manual onboarding depending on customer setup. For Dedicated/Private deployments where customers require delegated on-prem approval, our private control plane supports SAML-backed admin SSO with optional SCIM-based initial authorizations.
- Approval workflow: request -> manager approval -> security review (for privileged roles) -> audit log entry and ticketing (we integrate with Jira/ServiceNow).
- Separation controls: privileged role assignment requires two-step approval for System Admin and Support Admin, with periodic attestation (90/180-day cadence configurable).

2) SCIM attribute mapping (scim_attribute_map_v2.csv)- The CSV contains: core attributes (userName, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work].value), enterprise attributes (employeeNumber, orgUnitPath), and a column for custom attribute namespace support (urn:custom:baystone:department). We support bulk provisioning, incremental delta syncs, and conflict resolution rules (last-writer-wins by timestamp, with tombstone support).
- Custom namespaces: we preserve custom attributes under tenant-scoped namespaces and allow attribute passthrough to our RBAC engine for policy decisions.

3) SAML trust boundaries and assertions- Hosted API: our control plane acts as the identity relying party; we validate assertions with audience restriction and in-bound certificate rotation (30-90 day recommended). We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
- Dedicated: same assertion validation, but keys/certificates can be customer-managed (KMS/HSM).
- Private: customers host the assertion endpoint in their VPC; Redwood supports signed assertions and encrypted NameIDs on request.
- Recommended settings: audienceRestriction to the exact ACS URL, subjectConfirmationMethod = bearer, and include attributes: email, persistentId, group membership (if used for RBAC).

4) Evidence and artifacts- Attached: provisioning matrix PDF (role definitions + approval steps), SCIM mapping CSV, and SAML implementation notes with example metadata snippets. We can produce logs for auditor review (audit log extract) under NDA/time-limited access if required.

Notes: we keep privileged-role assignments immutable for forensic purposes; any change is a new versioned assignment with auditor-visible metadata.

Happy to hop on a short technical call if your audit team wants to walk the artifacts.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
